entry.title: Active Learning with Generative AI in Introductory Physics: A Multi-Institutional Study of the P-A.I.R. Framework
entry.summary: We evaluated P-A.I.R. in 11 algebra- and calculus-based introductory physics sections at four U.S. institutions using a common end-of-semester survey. Most students reported improved conceptual understanding. Thematic analysis of open-ended responses showed that students valued AI primarily for conceptual clarification and structured problem solving.
